NTPC Assistant Officer Online Form 2026 – Full Details

National Thermal Power Corporation (NTPC) has released the notification for the post of Assistant Officer (Corporate Communication). This recruitment has been issued for 15 posts. The online application process for NTPC Assistant Officer Recruitment 2026 has started from 21 September 2026, and candidates can apply till 05 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for NTPC Assistant Officer Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 21 September 2026
  • Last Date : 05 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 05 October 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, PwBD : 0/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification (English)
  • Download Notification (Hindi)
  • Official Website
